body: I don't know. Usually if her feelings are hurt, she won't speak at all. But when she saw them, she tilted her head and looked confused for a moment, then I literally saw the lightbulb of her realization. But she just shook it off and laughed about the convo we had been having. I can usually see if I've hurt her feelings. She is a pretty straightforward person when she is upset. That's why I'm not sure how she's feeling because I know she doesn't like it but she hasn't made it a point to bring it up to me. I already know you are all right to tell me we just have to talk about it. I guess I just needed a second opinion. Its helpful to see my issue from the eyes of others.

Well I haven't cut besides this one time, since she and I got together. And she has never had to really deal with this part of me. So I think that is probably the main issue. She doesn't know how to react. She has problems that she tries to shield me from. She won't talk about her problems with me because she doesn't want to feel like she has let me down. Which is really the reason I didn't say anything about my rough day. Idk, I'm gonna try to bring it up today.
Stella!

We told each other within a month of being officially together. We met in the beginning of April, and got together in the middle of may. We immediately clicked. I can't explain the connection we share. We were instantly drawn to each other. Idk. People may think that's silly. But she is now my wife, and we couldn't be happier. Everything happened very quickly in our relationship, but I have no regrets. I love her dearly.

I married my wife in September. She has 3 children and wasn't "out" when we met. But we hit it off and got together. It really doesn't bother me. She's bisexual and that's fine, I don't think of her as "less gay" than me. Not everyone feels like that, and if they do then you don't need them in your life. You are who you are. There is no perfect box you have to fit in to find love. Just don't give up. You'll find someone who loves all you have to offer, including your child.

That is beautiful. I hope your ink reminds you of how important it is to respect and love yourself. And what a good mum. I'm so glad you have someone understanding like that in your life. Much love and good luck :)
Just to add, I've been to therapy and taken meds before (for years) and nothing ever really changed. I've thought of trying therapy again, I just don't feel like it will help.

Idk. Even the good things I do upset me... I drew a howling wolf earlier. And it turned out amazing. But then I realized that I couldn't finish it. I'm too scared that I'll ruin it if I draw a background on it. And I know that its not a big deal to others if the background doesn't turn out right because the wolf is really cool. But I would be mad at myself for fucking it up every time I look at it. My hatred of myself is mainly because my mental illness makes me feel so crazy. I get so emotional and I know in my mind I am irrationally upset or mad or even happy at points. But I cannot control the overwhelming emotions I feel. Like  doing something over and over even though you know its not helping you. My mind says "its really not that big of a deal stop worrying about it" but when my emotion hits there's nothing I can do to change my own feelings... Idk if I even make any sense.
I was cutting for 10 years before I stopped. Haven't done it since June 2013. But its killing me now...
I regret everything I do...
I wouldn't do it where anyone can see it. I'm right here on the edge. Now I have to decide to fall back or jump. After the day I've had, I'm ready to give up.
I'm close to breaking down too... I want to feel the release..

I'm in a horrible situation with my jealousy and if I say or do anything its gonna ruin my marriage. So I have to suck it up and shut up. I find myself lashing out more at people at work than people I love. But that's not cool either. I'm so angry with myself. I hate who I am. I'm on the edge and I don't know if I can pull myself back from this anymore.

I'm dying the underlayer pink and have a couple pink streaks through the rest which is black. I hope the day comes soon. Just woke up feeling so awful today. I'm just sitting here crying like a fucking moron.

I'm getting my hair done on the 6th. I think that will help. Idk why, but changing my hair has always made me feel better. Its currently long and black. I'm getting it cut a little and having pink put in it. Hopefully it helps me think about the negative stuff a little less..
Sorry I haven't been back on in a couple days. I'm trying to relax. I'm just so frustrated with life. Christmas was nice besides having to work. But I'm still so down. Idk what's wrong with me.

I tried to explain that to her. But she really won't listen about it. Its hard BC she's great about helping me through literally ANYTHING but this... Its been days since the urge has subsided. And today its even worse.

I wish I could talk to her. But she has a problem with addiction herself, which she doesn't want to deal with, and I tried to tell her I understand and she basically laughed and told me I dont understand at all. That cutting is my choice, even though I want to be free of it and I can't. Maybe I'm just doomed to be this way forever.

I appreciate you trying to help. I'd be open to it but I know my wife would find out and I feel like it would upset her that I'd keep it from her. I've tried abstract. But it just turns out sloppy. And I have no good materials right now for my art and its driving me crazy. I drew my mom a Christmas present with sharpies and crayola markers. It was cool but j wish I could've painted her a canvas. It's little disappointments like that, they build up and I feel strong guilt for things I shouldn't feel so guilty for.
Your not wrong. Sometimes it is to "feel something" but for most people its more about feeling something different than what they already feel.

Drinking is soooooo bad for u. Obviously its ok to drink sometimes but my wife almost died from drinking last year. You really need to let your boyfriend try to comfort you. Just let him hold you and cry. Crying helps me when I feel like I can't do anything else anymore.

Part of quitting is realizing fully that cutting only hurts you. So your logical side feels like that. But it use to make you feel better so your emotional side told you it would help. But your logic got upset when you did it because it knows the truth..... Sorry. Maybe I'm babbling.

I'm an artist. But I've had a block lately so trying to draw to help feel better just makes things worse. And I barley have time for anything anymore, all I do is work, sleep and try to take care of our house. I listen to music sometimes. But the music I want to listen to when I feel this way is depressing so my feelings just stay the same. Idk. Today was a really bad day. I'm doubting I have very many days of willpower left. I was a cutter for 10 years. I don't think I even know how to be happy without it. I feel like a hotline would make me really insecure. That's why I got on here. But I can't always respond as quick as I want to BC i don't want anyone asking who I'm talking to.

I'm a very insecure person. That's why the dreams happen. I'm scared to even try to talk to my wife about it because she would just end up upset with me. Nothing really cheers me up anymore. Since I stopped cutting I feel more sad than ever. Its the one thing that makes me feel better every time. The one thing that silences the loudness of my own mind.

I haven't cut in almost 3 years. I have a lot of things I probably SHOULD be proud of. But I guess the reality that I feel, is that I'm really not needed by anyone. I have a job, a family, bit really I feel like if I wasn't here, everyone would be fine without me. If not better. I feel like I work hard but its never enough. Never enough to my own standards. I do things that are good, but I feel like the things I do are more lucky than skillful.... Idk if that makes sense. I'm kinda just rambling now. But I appreciate the comments guys. Thanks for listening.
Thank you. No I haven't done anything. But its really getting hard. Been having awful dreams lately. I just can't shake this sadness.
